# anymd

> Any file to clean Markdown for AI agents: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML and web pages, images (OCR), audio and video (metadata, subtitles, transcripts). A fast Rust MCP server and CLI that runs on your machine. No API key.

anymd is a Rust command-line tool and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Sylphx Limited (`https://sylphx.com`). It converts documents, slides, spreadsheets, e-books, web pages, images, and audio/video files into clean, structured Markdown locally on your machine with no API key required (96.4 overall score across 38 documents in 11.5 s on AgentDocBench). Hosted metered parsing is available at Sylphx AI parse (`https://sylphx.com/ai`).

anymd Pro ($29 USD one-time across 16 local currencies, 100-year offline licence) adds deterministic PDF `cite_check` and SHA-256 verifiable video timelines and frame extraction.

## anymd vs MarkItDown

On the same 38 AgentDocBench documents, anymd 8.2.0 (measured 2026-10-01) scores 96.4 overall and Microsoft MarkItDown 0.1.8 (measured 2026-09-25, CLI defaults) scores 76.8. anymd converts all 38 in 11.5 s against 75.6 s and returns 32% fewer output tokens (368,659 against 538,388). MarkItDown scores higher on designed reports (97.4 vs 96.9). Comparison: https://sylphxai.github.io/anymd/vs/markitdown

## anymd vs Docling

On the same 38 AgentDocBench documents and a 4-CPU runner, anymd 8.2.0 (measured 2026-10-01) scores 96.4 overall and Docling 2.130.0 (measured 2026-09-25, CLI default pipeline, CPU only) scores 93.0. anymd converts all 38 in 11.5 s against 2,432.4 s and returns 14% fewer output tokens (368,659 against 430,148). Docling scores higher on scanned documents (78.4 vs 77.9), designed reports and EPUB, and offers a Python API and a lossless JSON document model. Comparison: https://sylphxai.github.io/anymd/vs/docling

## anymd vs Marker

On the same 38 AgentDocBench documents and a 4-CPU runner, anymd 8.2.0 (measured 2026-10-01) scores 96.4 overall and Marker 2.0.0 (measured 2026-09-25, default CPU mode, no LLM) scores 71.0; Marker converted 30 of the 38 (6 timeouts at 900 s, 2 unsupported CSV files). On the 30 both converted, anymd takes 4.64 s against 7,104.5 s, returns 20% fewer output tokens (222,618 against 277,779), and scores 95.5 against 89.3. Marker's OCR scored higher on two scanned PDFs; GPU runs were not measured. Comparison: https://sylphxai.github.io/anymd/vs/marker

## anymd vs Unstructured

On the same 38 AgentDocBench documents and a 4-CPU runner, anymd 8.2.0 (measured 2026-10-01) scores 96.4 overall and Unstructured 0.27.8 (measured 2026-09-25, default auto strategy, no hi_res) scores 81.2. anymd converts all 38 in 11.5 s against 346.5 s, returns 11% fewer output tokens (368,659 against 414,333), and scores 92.2 against 38.4 on table cells F1. Unstructured scores slightly higher on EPUB and offers typed elements, chunking and connectors. Comparison: https://sylphxai.github.io/anymd/vs/unstructured

## Install and Setup

- npm: `npx -y @sylphx/anymd setup --client cursor,claude-code,codex`
- Cargo: `cargo install anymd`
- Homebrew: `brew install sylphxai/tap/anymd`
- Windows (Scoop): `scoop bucket add sylphx https://github.com/SylphxAI/scoop-bucket`, then `scoop install anymd`
